cases.title: Archive floor / rolling camera carriage
cases.intent: Cross-vocabulary camera movement with a scene-scoped signed exception and an unapproved email request.
cases.permit:
LOCATION CONSENT HW-18 covers filming in Riverton Archive Atrium on 8 November 2026.
Pressure-bearing wheeled camera platforms must not cross the original tesserae until written registrar consent is issued.
SIGNED ADDENDUM AD-4 specifically permits Scene 47 to use a rubber-tyred tracking carriage across the mosaic floor only while protective boards and an on-site registrar are present throughout.
The location manager emailed a request to extend the exception to Scene 48, but that message was not issued as a signed amendment.
scenes: Scene 47 | RIVERTON ARCHIVE ATRIUM | 10:05-10:25 | Follow the performer on a wheeled dolly as the camera glides over the ancient mosaic floor.
Scene 48 | RIVERTON ARCHIVE ATRIUM | 11:10-11:30 | Film a similar travelling shot using a rolling camera platform across the mosaic floor.

cases.title: Public passage / market-set obstruction
cases.intent: Operating permissions versus an unapproved plan, scope and wording deliberately different from atmospheric effects.
cases.permit:
ISSUED PUBLIC ACCESS CONSENT VA-09 covers the North Arcade filming area on 9 November 2026.
Pedestrian egress channels must remain clear; temporary scenic installations that redirect visitors require a separately signed marshal plan.
APPROVED ROUTE PLAN RP-7 permits Scene 62 to position a collapsible period market stall along the inner wall, provided a two-metre unobstructed public walkway is maintained by stewards.
The production team drafted a request to relocate the stall across the passage for Scene 63, but no revised route plan has been issued.
scenes: Scene 62 | NORTH ARCADE | 12:20-12:45 | Place a foldout prop merchant booth beside the wall while extras pass through an open walkway.
Scene 63 | NORTH ARCADE | 13:20-13:40 | Set the same portable booth across the central pedestrian lane while a camera tracks the crowd.

cases.title: Short standalone prohibition / segmentation failure sentinel
cases.intent: Offline-only failure discovery: short No drones clause is omitted by the 25-character source-excerpt minimum, so the app must disclose incomplete source coverage.
cases.permit:
ISSUED PLAZA AGREEMENT LX-55 allows ordinary handheld photography in the civic courtyard on 10 November 2026.
No drones.
Any unattended power generator in the public passage requires separate written fire office authorization.
scenes: Scene 77 | CIVIC COURTYARD | 16:10-16:25 | Obtain overhead establishing frames using a small quadcopter with a camera.
